82b5947d-abd0-419f-af9f-34e714dcfa77.content: librarian #1006 (AMD 55758 v1.13 p.60-69): SMN flash window documented only as 0x44000000-0x44FFFFFF; 44/45/46/47xxxxxx are four 16 MB SPI regions selected by XOR of addr bits 24/25 (SPI Addr32_Ctrl3 page bit, alt-image strap). Our 0x47000000 = alias of 0x44000000 is a MODEL ASSUMPTION (valid while all four regions hold the same 16 MiB). SMU base 0x03c00000 undocumented. Not documented anywhere: PSP-private map, IC, CCP, timers, x86 slots, MP0 C2PMSG addrs, fuse bank. Reference: 127.0.0.1:8860/milan-psp-reference.md (local only).
